digest.component_or_area: LLM sub-call model-class resolution across plan-review/review/code-review gates
propositions: Four hand-built RunRequest sub-calls pass config=cfg with no model class and inherit cfg.model, bypassing the three-class configuration.
overlap-judge makes 18 of 23 plan-review LLM calls and, under a class-only Bedrock cutover, keeps the majority of plan-review traffic on direct Anthropic.
ticket-digest runs on the ticket store write path via enrich_drain.maybe_drain, sending ticket content to direct Anthropic during ordinary rebar comment/create with no gate or verdict revealing it.
A regression test must pin the class-only configuration (classes on Bedrock, cfg.model bare-anthropic) because a config with cfg.model also on Bedrock passes even with the bug unfixed.
The overlap-judge test must deliberately construct the BM25F candidate condition since the judge only fires when retrieval returns non-empty candidates excluding the query's own graph.

The fix binds each site to a justified class (ticket-digest trivial, overlap-judge and code-novelty standard, ticket-quality frontier) and adds a general AST provenance guard preventing any future sub-call from silently inheriting cfg.model, while preserving fail-safe abstain/degrade behaviour.
